parent_objective: materialize the metric-specific bounded panel without rollout
blocked_by: M1770 admits no-rollout materialization preflight before reset or measured execution
supersedes: direct bounded-panel execution without materialization audit

public_gates: M1771 must be no-rollout materialization only
M1771 must produce 24 specs, 4 role panels, 6 specs per role, 12 profiles, and 288 cells
M1771 must write a role/metric contract and preserve labels as metadata-only
M1771 must not run reset, policy rollout, train, replay, PPO, promote, use private holdout, tune profiles, or rank controller families

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: materializes the bounded role-separated panel and metric contract without rollout
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: no-rollout materialization only; no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if materialization cannot produce all 24 specs and 288 cells
stop if any selected row has labels entering actor input
stop if unsupported fault modes are treated as covered
stop if materialization would require profile tuning
fallback_plan: route to design repair if panel counts or role balance fail
route to semantics audit if role metric contract is ambiguous
route to materialization result audit if preflight passes

admission_evidence: M1770 defines a 24-spec 288-cell metric-specific bounded panel and materialization route
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: bounded panel materialization helper if needed
M1771 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up manifest for result audit

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: not applicable; M1771 materializes task-quality panel metadata and does not test history necessity.
history_necessity_tests: Materialization must preserve profile controls for later history-necessity evidence.
self_id_evidence_discipline.temporal_evidence_window: M1770 design and M1767 localization artifacts only.
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If materialization fails, classify as panel-design or metric-contract evidence, not self-ID evidence.
allowed_claims: no reset, rollout, training, replay, PPO, private-holdout, promotion, paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: The M1770 bounded panel can be materialized as 24 role-balanced specs crossed with 12 profiles without violating the actor/input or no-ranking contracts.
failure_criteria: materialization runs reset or policy rollout
role metric contract is missing or ambiguous
actor input or ranking guardrails are violated

commands.name: materialize
commands.command: materialize bounded panel artifacts without reset or rollout

decision_rule: M1771 passes if it materializes the bounded panel and metric contract with exact counts and zero guardrail violations.
